# Later visible freshness protocol — UNRUN

This is an authored handoff protocol, not a Map implementation, browser action,
host claim or accepted visible result. Root owns later finite admission; Map's
later LOS143 consumer phase and Leah own the applicable visible acceptance.
The independent Map LOS153 writer must not adopt this new API as a prerequisite.

1. Settle reviewed Core+later Map artifact identities, package manifests and
   installed-card results. Use only the temporary public fixture and an isolated
   admitted test surface; keep both existing demos and Leah's browser untouched.
2. Configure the allowed workspace root explicitly on the operator/server side.
   The browser never supplies an arbitrary root, and a saved manifest never

3. Open Source on saved A with CURRENT B and disk B. Confirm the visible source,

4. Through one explicit, accessible comparison action, compare the selected saved

5. Confirm ordinary Check still names saved integrity separately and reports its

   No automatic refresh, watcher, evaluation or application execution is added.
6. Exercise keyboard focus, literal action/result labels, no-JavaScript behavior
   and readable narrow/zoom views under that later phase's actual UI ownership.
   Ask Leah to explain saved A, CURRENT B and the comparison's point-in-time

7. Retain exact requests/results, artifact identities, protected store-file
